I am old now, 87 years, and my hands are not strong like before. This small maize plot near the house I work myself, but slowly. I have no money for the shop fertilizer, so I will put the manure from my few goats and chickens, like my mother taught me. The seed I save from last harvest — improved seed costs too much and I do not trust to buy every year.
